Hi Sara / team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to get the pilot set up. Before we provision Dedicated capacity, finance has one ask around how you want invoices and VAT handled so we don’t slow procurement/PO issuance. Two quick questions:

1) Do you need separate legal-entity invoices (Helix Labs UK Ltd vs Helix Labs GmbH) for VAT reclaim purposes? If yes, please confirm the billing addresses, VAT IDs, and corresponding PO numbers so we can issue invoices per-entity.

2) If you prefer a single consolidated invoice, can you confirm whether your accounting team will accept a consolidated invoice that includes cost-center codes (internal chargebacks) plus per-line VAT breakdowns? That option is possible but has limitations in EU reclaim workflows.

We usually recommend:
- For EU customers with multiple legal entities: separate invoices per legal entity (cleanest for VAT).
- For centralized accounting: consolidated invoice with per-line cost-center mapping and accompanying CSV for internal allocation.

Attached is a short checklist we use (redwood-multientity-guide.xlsx) and we can mirror your PO numbers into our billing system once you confirm. If it helps, below is a sample layout we can produce on every invoice:
  - Invoice header: legal entity name, VAT number, billing address
  - Line items: subscription SKU, start/end, net amount, VAT percent, VAT amount
  - Metadata: PO number, internal cost-center code, Helix project code

Next steps: if you can reply with preferred approach + VAT IDs and POs, we’ll lock the billing config and push the pilot account live.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
